title: US midterms put tech oligarchs in the political crosshairs
teaser: The US midterms are becoming a test of whether tech companies can ignore public opposition. Resistance to data centers is appearing in campaigns across the country, while opposition to AI, surveillance cameras and the companies behind them is drawing people with different politics into the same fight. Rebecca Solnit argues that the stakes reach beyond local disputes over land, water and electricity: voters may also be deciding whether corporations and their owners can dictate the terms of public life.
